name: Woods-N-Waters Kampground
note: Campground south of Columbus with water/electric ($54) and full-hookup ($59) RV sites for two adults (2026, before tax), a pool and a fishing pond; Campspot booking. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: woods-n-waters.com live with a 2026 rate table (W/E $54, W/E/S $59) and Campspot booking; RV Life 4* $$ (avg ~$39) over 136 reviews - passes the price gate on tier (docs/campground-curation.md)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 39.1203,-85.9664: RV loop around a pool and office with a small fishing pond to the south; sites not on the pond bank - not waterfront

name: Quaker Haven Camp
note: Friends (Quaker) church camp near Syracuse that rents tent and RV sites to the public by the night: RV 30-amp $51, 50-amp $56, primitive with 20-amp $41 (up to 5 people). No pets. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: quakerhaven.com live with a tent-and-RV rate page (30A $51, 50A $56 per night); RV Life 5* $$ over 2 reviews; Google 4.9 over 110 with phone (read 2026-10-02). A church camp that rents its campground nightly to the public is a keep (MI precedent: Covenant Hills, Winding Creek)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 41.3670,-85.7604: camp buildings above the lakeshore with cottages along the water; the RV/tent sites are not legible and are not shown on the bank - not waterfront
